test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The radius of the base and height of a cone are 5 cm and 6 cm, respectively, whereas the radius of the base and height of a cylinder are 2.5 cm and 3 cm, respectively. The ratio of the volume of the cone to that of the cylinder is: (Where π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of the cone, r꜀ₒₙₑ = 5 cm

Height of the cone, h꜀ₒₙₑ = 6 cm

Radius of the base of the cylinder, r꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = 2.5 cm

Height of the cylinder, h꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = 3 cm

π = 22/7

**Concept:**

The volume of a cone is given by:

V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) π r꜀ₒₙₑ² h꜀ₒₙₑ

The volume of a cylinder is given by:

V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = π r꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ² h꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) × (22/7) × (5)² × 6

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3) × (22/7) × 25 × 6

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = (22/21) × 150

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = 22 × (150/21)

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ = 22 × 7.14

⇒ V꜀ₒₙₑ ≈ 157.08 cm³

⇒ V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = (22/7) × (2.5)² × 3

⇒ V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = (22/7) × 6.25 × 3

⇒ V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = (22/7) × 18.75

⇒ V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = 22 × (18.75/7)

⇒ V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = 22 × 2.68

⇒ V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ ≈ 59.06 cm³

Ratio of the volume of the cone to that of the cylinder:

⇒ (V꜀ₒₙₑ / V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ) ≈ 157.08 / 59.06

⇒ Ratio ≈ 2.66

⇒ Ratio ≈ 8 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
